officialCountNormalization.exactRelevantText: 当特指某张或某类〖杀〗的特性时，将以往描述中使用的“无次数限制”（已达到杀的限制次数后依然可以使用，但会计入次数）和“不计入次数”（使用时不会消耗一次杀的限制次数，但在已达到杀的限制次数后不可使用）合并为“无次数限制”（既能在达到限制次数后使用，也不会消耗使用次数），如枪舞、怒斩、龙怒、成略、武神、奋钺、缮甲、流矢、挽弓、擢升、龙吟、追猎等。

boundedOfficialFaqAudit.result: Located current hero/Config, historical official launch and explicit 2022 count normalization. No dedicated primary ruling for zero-entity or mixed-material use, transfer/reacquisition, BorrowedSword paired targets or equipment child timing located in this bounded search.

engineMappingsNotOfficialFaq.topic: Positive round acquisition and stable excluded source
engineMappingsNotOfficialFaq.status: Coordinator implementation contract; no dedicated official interaction FAQ located
engineMappingsNotOfficialFaq.mapping: A material requires a genuine acquisition by this owner during the exact actual round, with matching movement provenance. Exclude entities acquired by this skill using stable owner/skill/policy/round identity. Source loss and regrant, leaving hand, or transfer/reacquisition do not erase an already-recorded same-round exclusion. Round boundaries reset round qualification. Initial deal alone is not acquisition in an actual started round.

engineMappingsNotOfficialFaq.status: Engine inference from positive physical-entity qualification; no direct official zero/mixed-material FAQ
engineMappingsNotOfficialFaq.mapping: Require at least one real physical material; every material must satisfy the positive round-acquisition predicate and none may carry the same-round skill exclusion. A pure zero-entity virtual use does not receive Zhuosheng benefits. A mixed set containing one unqualified or excluded entity does not qualify; ordinary single-material conversions are tested against their real entity. This batch admits only actual actor-provided materials (ActorSeat equals ProviderSeat). Preflight requires every material currently in a genuine location owned by that actor; historical acquisition alone cannot borrow a card now held by a foreign provider. Once native Use qualification is issued before payment, its paid continuation validates the exact frozen acquisition/Use proof without requiring those already-paid cards or the original skill instance to remain owned/live.

engineMappingsNotOfficialFaq.status: Unlimited Slash quota semantics officially clarified; exact engine issuance is an implementation mapping
engineMappingsNotOfficialFaq.mapping: During the actual actor Play phase, issue the qualifying-use benefit before physical materials depart. Basic-card native distance and applicable use-count limits are bypassed, including exhausted quota, and no quota is debited. Preserve target prohibitions and native effect semantics; a Response is not a qualifying Play-phase Use.

engineMappingsNotOfficialFaq.status: Engine target model mapping; no direct official BorrowedSword interaction FAQ
engineMappingsNotOfficialFaq.mapping: Offer one optional addition or removal at exact native finalized targets after physical cost. Preserve native target legality and existing target order. BorrowedSword counts weapon owners as primary targets and adds/removes the complete weapon-owner/victim pair; do not treat the victim as a second primary or silently exclude BorrowedSword. Existing legal pair rules permit repeated victim seats when appropriate.

engineMappingsNotOfficialFaq.topic: Equipment commitment and self-skill drawn entities
engineMappingsNotOfficialFaq.status: Engine timing/source mapping; no direct official committed-window FAQ
engineMappingsNotOfficialFaq.mapping: Observe the real actor equipment Use commitment after native equipment placement, then draw exactly one through the owning typed native continuation and drain movement/HP children. Freeze exact accepted use and producer before suspension, prevent duplicate rewards after cold restore, and record the actual drawn entities as this skill acquisition so they cannot recursively benefit this round.
